lastCompletedStory.title: Refuse a store-reaching recursive-search oracle at filing time

nextStoryContext: validateSpec now refuses a criterion whose [oracle: ...] directive (named-command or file-assert, extracted via parseOracleDirective from src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts) is a recursive grep/egrep/fgrep/rg search whose root reaches scripts/cam/issues. The detection core is exported as a standalone pure predicate, findStoreReachingSearch(command): { root: string } | null, from the new leaf module src/issues/self-contaminating-search.ts -- this is the SAME module US-003 must import into src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts (do not re-implement the path parsing there; push one new OracleLintRule named exactly 'self-contaminating-search' onto RULES at prd-oracle-lint.ts:640, whose test(command) calls findStoreReachingSearch(command) and returns a RuleFinding when it returns non-null). Detection rules implemented: (1) recursive = grep/egrep/fgrep with -r/-R (bundled short-flag group or --recursive), or any rg invocation (recursive by default, no flag needed); (2) a root is store-reaching when it is '.', or a directory-ancestor-or-equal of scripts/cam/issues ('scripts', 'scripts/cam', 'scripts/cam/issues', trailing slash tolerated), or when the invocation carries NO positional root at all (defaults to cwd, represented as root '.'); the ancestor-prefix test naturally exempts a single FILE under scripts (e.g. scripts/cam/patterns.md) even with -r, since a file path is never an ancestor-of-or-equal to the store directory; (3) an explicit --exclude-dir=issues or --exclude-dir issues (space-separated) anywhere in the invocation nullifies the finding for that invocation regardless of its roots -- this is the sanctioned CAM-460 AC2 repair idiom and must stay accepted. The tokenizer is quote-aware at the token level (a quoted span is one atomic token, so a quoted alternation pattern containing '|' does not fragment into false positional tokens) and skips shell-redirection tokens (2>/dev/null) and stops an invocation's argument walk at a clause separator (|, &&, ||, ;) -- verified directly against the real CAM-460 AC2 oracle text (a bash -c wrapper with a piped 'wc -l' and a quoted alternation pattern), which correctly resolves to { root: 'scripts' }. Cognitive-complexity note for whoever touches this file next: scanInvocationTokens is decomposed into matchExcludeDirIssues / isRecursiveShortFlag / applyToken (a mutable-state-threading per-token classifier) specifically to stay under the biome lint/complexity/noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity ceiling of 15 -- adding new flag-handling branches directly inline into the for-loop in scanInvocationTokens will likely trip that gate again; extend applyToken or add a new small helper instead. validateSpec itself delegates the new criteria-scanning loop to findSelfContaminatingSearchErrors (also for the same complexity-budget reason) -- keep new validateSpec logic in small extracted helpers, not inline in the main function body.
